title: Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon
subtitle: Alola takes another path

body: Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon are Game Freak's expanded Nintendo 3DS role-playing adventures returning to the island region of Alola. They revisit Sun and Moon with an alternate storyline centred on Necrozma, new characters and additional activities. The player's journey through the region retains its familiar battles, exploration and growing team, while the Ultra Recon Squad and new forms of Legendary Pokémon change the larger mystery. These were the final mainline Pokémon releases for the 3DS family, giving the portable generation one more substantial version of its distinctive tropical setting.

Ultra Warp Ride allows travel through Ultra Wormholes into other destinations, including the worlds associated with Ultra Beasts. Mantine Surf offers another way to move between the islands' seas, connecting a new activity to the region's geography. Totem Stickers provide a collectible route toward unusually large Pokémon, while the Alola Photo Club lets a trainer pose with a companion. These additions broaden what can occupy the journey between major encounters. The familiar adventure gains more reasons to move around its islands and to spend time with the team already assembled.

The post-game Team Rainbow Rocket story brings together leaders from earlier antagonistic teams, extending the adventure's connection to Pokémon history. Necrozma's new forms also make its relationship with Solgaleo or Lunala central to the visual identity of the two versions. The expanded structure mixes that retrospective interest with further discoveries in Ultra Space. Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon give returning players another account of Alola, using new routes and encounters to keep a recognisable place active after the broad outline of its first journey has become familiar.
